name: Barbell Finger Curl
steps: Sit upright on a bench with your forearms flat on your thighs and hold a barbell palms-up with your wrists extending past your knees.
Keep your wrists flat and open your fingers slowly so the bar rolls safely down toward your fingertips.
Close your fingers firmly to curl the bar tightly back into your palms.
Lower the bar slowly back down into your fingers under full control.
tips: Keep your wrists still so your finger flexors perform the movement rather than your wrists.
Use a manageable weight so the bar never slips past your fingertips.
